verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Brex's API surface (Accounting, Budgets, Webhooks, Team, Payments, Expenses) and AI-powered automation features (invoice entry, GL coding), but nothing describes scheduling recurring jobs, cron-like workflows, or automated recurring task execution for an AI-native user. Webhooks only support event-driven triggers, not recurring scheduling. Missing for 10: any documentation of a scheduler, recurring job API, cron-style automation, or workflow orchestration with recurrence.
